units.source_text: 薰中纳言对她说道：“投身而死，其实罪孽甚重。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said to her, "To throw yourself away and die is in truth a very grave sin.

units.source_text: 死者原可到达极乐净土，但投身自杀者不能，反会沉入地狱中极深的底层，又何苦呢！

en.t: The dead might otherwise reach the Pure Land of bliss, but those who kill themselves by casting themselves away cannot; instead they sink to the deepest depths of hell, so what is the use?

units.source_text: 只要悟得世间一切皆空就好了。”

en.t: It is enough simply to realize that everything in this world is empty."
